text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Spring Stakes. It would 
have been a tough distance before her 
debut, but now, she can run all out to the 
end—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon shows confidence. Yet, she 
also hints at a readiness to change course 
if the results do not follow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Stakes, the touchstone for the 
Satsuki Sho, is about to begin.
